abstract: Agent skill for verl, the RL post-training library for LLMs: install with uv or Docker, GRPO/PPO and other algorithms on FSDP or Megatron with vLLM or SGLang rollouts, custom reward functions, multi-node Ray, Slurm and SkyPilot, checkpoint merging, troubleshooting and updating. References split by install, training, rewards, scaling, checkpoints, troubleshooting and updating, plus a single-GPU GRPO template.
